criteria.hypothesis: sound facilitates the giant fiber's response to a near-threshold loom (Tootoonian et al. 2012, J Neurosci 32:787-798, Fig. 2D), and does so beyond what adding the model's own measured sound-alone potential to the loom alone predicts

protocol.child: benchmarks/auditory.py 40 <data_dir> as a full run with FLYCNS_A2_TRIALS = trials_per_arm (FLYCNS_AUDITORY_OUT, FLYCNS_A2_GAIN and FLYCNS_A2_ONLY removed)
protocol.working_point: calibrated per run over loom gains [0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.3] on seeds BASE + 1000 + gain index: the largest gain with loom-alone GF hit <= 0.3 and mean depolarisation >= 2 mV
protocol.arms: loom alone on seed BASE, loom + sound on seed BASE + 1 (BASE = LIFParams().seed); sound = the auditory JO types at 150 Hz during each 60 ms loom burst
protocol.statistics: A2R: Newcombe 1998 method 10 interval on the difference, recomputed from counts. A2R2: percentile bootstrap of observed minus summation-predicted response, each arm resampled on its own

A2R_facilitation.rule: PASS if the 95% interval on P(GF | loom + sound) - P(GF | loom) lies above 0; FAIL if below 0; FAIL also if it spans 0 (fixed in advance: unresolved at this trial count)

A2R2_beyond_summation.condition: scored when the auditory report carries A2_construction (the registered auditory.py always writes it); otherwise UNRESOLVED
A2R2_beyond_summation.rule: facilitation beyond summation: PASS if the 95% interval on the observed P(GF | loom + sound) minus the probability predicted by adding each giant fiber's measured sound-alone peak depolarisation (same run) to its loom-alone peak, per trial, lies above 0; the interval resamples all three arms; FAIL if at or below 0; UNRESOLVED if it spans 0

Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 10 mV under the measured stationary loom input (refit 2026-10-10, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at 1.95, close to its limit of 2). Earlier 30 mV was fitted under the all-trials input; a 15 mV value came from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 7 spikes per loom.
